newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia first-half industry output up 34.62 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia first-half industry output up 34.62 pct.

text.p: Mongolia's gross industrial output at current prices rose 34.62 percent in the first half of the year from the same period of 1996, the State Statistical Bulletin said on Tuesday.
It gave actual output value during the January-June period as 136.970 billion tugriks compared with 101.748 billion last year.
The main increases were in energy, mining and food industries, the figures showed.

Coal mining output in the six-month period was 12.791 billion tugriks, up from 6.729 billion in the year-ago period, while electricity and thermal energy generation rose to 36.18 billion tugriks, up from 18.28 billion.

The first half output from the mining of metal ores climbed to 34.63 billion tugriks from 24.64 billion last year while production of food and beverages increased to 23.897 billion tugriks from 18.72 billion.
